title: Case Key Takeaways
description: Case Analysis and implication of the CISIAM, sole fund manager for Tahoe Life's private fund, committed 92% of assets to structured notes linked to bonds of Tahoe Life's affiliate, Tahoe Group — breaching mandate limits. After Tahoe Group's 2020 default, NAV fell 57%. The SFC fined CISIAM HK$6.8 million for inadequate due diligence and risk oversight.
